decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be completed within 6 months from the date of this approval.  Failure to complete the works in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith, hereby approved, will result in enforcement action being implemented.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The rear dormer shall be set-down a minimum of 0.25 m from the roof ridge as shown on the Side Elevation, drawing number LD3833/1.
description: Reduction of rear roof extension to the house.
